errors.evidence: The figure is a compound chart consisting of a pie chart and a stacked bar chart. Describing the entire figure as just a pie chart is an inaccurate simplification of its structure, even though the bar is mentioned later.

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns percentages to the sub-sectors of renewable energy. The correct values shown in the stacked bar chart are: Geothermal 3.1%, Ambient heat 5.3%, Solar 6.3%, Wind 12.7%, Hydro 13.6%, and Bioenergy & waste 58.9%. The description scrambles most of these values and omits the numerical value for 'биоенергия и отпадъци'.
The description omits the vertical axis of the stacked bar chart, which ranges from 0% to 100%.
The description does not mention the legend for the stacked bar chart, which is located below the bar and maps colors to the different types of renewable energy.
